title: Build a Platform From Zero
intro: Before any app is deployed, someone has to design the network, provision machines safely, prepare their disks and services, and stand up the cluster. This is that someone's week.
resolution: Decisions made at the start of this path are the hardest to change later: CIDR ranges that overlap a future VPN or pod network, Terraform state kept on one laptop, a disk mounted without an fstab entry, a service started but not enabled, a pod network CIDR chosen without checking the VPC. Each one is cheap to get right on day one and genuinely painful to fix on day three hundred — which is why platform work rewards slowing down and verifying every step.
